'''Lady Finndal''' is an [[Andor]]an noblewoman. She is married.
==History==
She was present with her husband, Lord [[Finndal]], at a banquet attended by [[Rodel Ituralde]] while [[Thom]] was still court bard in [[Caemlyn]]. Thom flirted with her at the end of one of his juggling tricks.
